                                              --- NHTSA_CMPL.txt ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                       CONSUMER COMPLAINTS                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       The COMPLAINTS file contains all safety-related defect complaints received                                                                                                                                                                   by NHTSA since January 1, 1995.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           File characteristics:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     -  All the records are TAB delimited                                                                                                                                                                                                         -  All dates are in YYYYMMDD format                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       -  Maximum record length: 2824                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            Change log:                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  1. Fields 21 - 46 were added on Sept. 14, 2007                                                                                                                                                                                               2. Changed flat file extension from .lst to .txt on Sept. 14, 2007                                                                                                                                                                           3. Field 47 was added on Oct. 15, 2007                                                                                                                                                                                                       4. Field 34 was changed from CHAR(20) to CHAR(30) on Aug. 08, 2008                                                                                                                                                                           5.                                                                                                                                            --- NHTSA_TSBS.txt ---                                                                                                                                                                                                                       Manufacturer Communications                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               The Manufacturer Communications files contains manufacturer communications received by NHTSA since January 1, 1995.                                                                                                                          There are two types of files: Comma Separated Values (CSV) and Tab Separated Values (TSV).                                                                                                                                                   Both are broken into 5-year chunks based on date received by NHTSA.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       The CSV file contains a small set of columns, such as the TSB/Document ID, product (Make, Model, Model Year) and Concise Summary of the communication.                                                                                       The CSV file contains one record per TSB/Document ID per product (Make, Model, Model Year).                                                                                                                                                  For example, if a communication applied to 5 products and 3 components, there would be 5 records for that communication in the CSV file.                                                                                                     The CSV file is intended to allow for basic keyword search of the Concise Summary.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        The TSV file (also called the "flat file") contains more data elements of the communication. All data elements are described below.                                                                                                          The TSV file contains one record per TSB/Document ID per any value of any data element that has multiple values (e.g., product and component).                                                                                               For example, if a communication applied to 5 products and 3 components, there would be 5 x 3 = 15 records for that communication in the TSV file.
